# FFmpeg / FFprobe — third-party notice (JW Converter)

This product bundles **FFmpeg** and **FFprobe** for local audio analysis and conversion.
FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard. These binaries are separate from JW Converter’s
own application license.

## Exact build shipped with this installer

- Identity: **ffmpeg 8.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev** (Gyan.dev Windows full build)
- License of this build: **GNU GPL v3** (`--enable-gpl --enable-version3` and related libraries)
- Obtained via: Gyan.dev / WinGet package lineage (`Gyan.FFmpeg`) for local packaging
- Tools: `ffmpeg.exe`, `ffprobe.exe`

Configuration for this build includes GPL-enabled encoders (for example libx264/libx265)
and many third-party libraries. See `ffmpeg -version` / `ffprobe -version` on an installed
copy for the full configure line.

## Corresponding source

FFmpeg’s licensing requires that corresponding source for GPL binaries you redistribute
be available.

- FFmpeg project / sources: https://ffmpeg.org/ and https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg
- Gyan Windows builds (binary origin used here): https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

**Source offer:** For three years after you receive this JW Converter installer, you may
request a copy of the corresponding source for the bundled FFmpeg/FFprobe binaries by
opening an issue at:

https://github.com/Salutatorian/jwconverter/issues

Describe that you need the FFmpeg corresponding source for the JW Converter release you
installed (include the app version from Settings → About).
